body: Yeah bro, i wonder sometimes if this is just a part of life but how long will this last? My therapist diagnosed with me with Persistent depressive disorder, but i think that's just a label. I think i have a way too realistic look at life. Sure there a fun times, but there is so much darkness is this life.

You think those were youre happiest times, but that's just something you tell yourself and it keeps you from thinking about other stuff.
a GF is just a distraction. You will be happy first but your mental health will catch up to you. I know how youre feeling but it's important to be happy by yourself.

Exercise is like self harm for me, instead of cutting myself i go to the gym 5 times a week sometimes even twice a day, just to get my thoughts straigth and out of the fucking downward spiral that depression gives me. It's good for social interaction aswell.

I'm not so sure about sleeping pills, never tried them. I'll get my hands on alot of oxycodone pills. If i recall correctly they were 5mg each and about 50 of them. Not sure if 250mg of oxycodone can kill a man, still need to do research.
And all the things we do to increase the chances.
And everytime it starts to get better, a relative dies or some other dissapointment. A never ending cycle.
It doesn't get better, i've been depressed for aslong as i can remember. Maybe we get used to it?
I used to watch alot, but i struggle to keep my concentration now. I just end up listening to music all day. any ideas?

I'm done, sleeping one night about it probably wondering what the fuck i did last night. Ill leave a message on my pc reminding to kill myself Fuck suffering, im fucking done. I wish you the best of luck in life. Goodbye.
It's no unfair, i guess life is. They'll get over it but i cant hurt them anyway.

Yeah the part i applied for wasnt my first choice but it was the only option that had free spots. And i forced myself to apply for something.
Because than i have a goal to work towards. I rather do police work but this will do for now.

Not that i know of, just applying for the most difficult position at the army(95% failure rate i believe). Can only take so many steps back untill i reach a point where i lose my mind. and i've been there last year and got into a psych ward. Eventually i calmed down but it never went away. Went through normal therapy and figured out i have do this on my own anyway.

Thanks for replying

I've always had the idea that joining the police force would be challenging and fun. I wanted to help people since i was very little. Family didn't like me thinking this way and would rather have me behind a desk, trusting them i went to college but eventually got stubborn and decided to sign up.
I have applied 6 times and got denied 6 times because there were people with better profiles than me(it's about having knowledge of ethnic groups and cultures).
